groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand doing something: grabbing, lifting, fighting.

chars.story: A hand stoops to the ground and takes up what was dropped.
chars.note: 撿 became 捡: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: A hand grips the edge of a lid and heaves it up.
A hand lands hard on you and you have to take it: suffer a blow.
chars.note: Also 'next to' (挨着) and 'one by one' (挨个).

chars.story: Hands grip hands and fight with all their strength.
A hand holds firm against the blow coming in: ward off.
A hand reaches down into the water to bring something up.
chars.note: 撈 became 捞: the right side was simplified.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: liquid and what it does.

chars.story: Water flung out of a bucket in one burst: it splashes everywhere.
chars.note: 潑 became 泼: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: Water gone thick enough to pour slowly: soy milk, plasma, magma.
chars.note: 漿 became 浆: the top part was simplified.

chars.story: Like water running off, it slides away before you can stop it.
Water spread wide and brimming: a flat expanse of it.
chars.note: Also a dog's bark (汪汪).

chars.story: An army wades through a stream and churns it into mud.
chars.note: 渾 became 浑: 軍 became 军.

groups.title: pools and floods 氵
groups.note: Water lying still, or rising over things.

chars.story: Earth banked up around a hollow of still water: a pond.
The water rises until everything is under it.
Water left to settle until you can see right to the bottom: limpid.

groups.title: names and places
groups.note: Characters you meet mostly in surnames and place names.

chars.story: Only grass on bare ground, empty and still: dreary.
chars.note: A surname (Xiao). 蕭 became 萧.

chars.story: Rice-washing water, now just a family name: Pan.
chars.note: Originally rice-washing water; you will meet it as a surname.

chars.story: The river that runs through Hunan gives the province its short name.
chars.note: Short name for Hunan province.

chars.story: A door onto the sea: the short name for Shanghai.
chars.note: Short name for Shanghai. 滬 became 沪.

groups.title: plants 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants and what grows.

chars.story: A tall water plant opening one big flower on the pond.
chars.note: Only seen in 芙蓉, a poetic name for the lotus bloom.

chars.story: Grass in flower, sweet on every side.
chars.note: Poetic 'fragrant': 芳香 'fragrance', and common in girls' names.

chars.story: A big-leaved plant growing in the garden.
chars.note: Mostly seen in 芭蕾 (ballet, a loanword) and 芭蕉.

chars.story: Grass left to grow wild, tangled and untidy.
chars.note: 蓬勃 is positive: bursting with growth.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: A tree on the left: wood and what grows on it.

chars.story: A tree cut low, with only its trunk left standing.
chars.note: Counts plants: 一株树 'one tree'.

chars.story: The wooden pivot of a door, the spot everything turns on.
chars.note: 樞 became 枢: 區 became 区.

chars.story: A tree whose fruit you cut with a sharp knife: a pear.
A tree as huge as an elephant: the oak.
chars.note: Also rubber: 橡胶.

chars.story: A bird settles on a branch as the sun sets in the west.
chars.note: 棲 became 栖: 妻 became 西.

chars.story: A small bush bearing hot little berries: pepper.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth on the left: breath and voice.

chars.story: The passage behind the mouth that food and voice pass through.
A mouth falling open when something suddenly makes sense: oh.
chars.note: An interjection, 'oh, I see'.

chars.story: A tree crowded with squawking mouths: a racket.

groups.title: flesh 月
groups.note: The 月 here is flesh, not moon: parts of the body.

chars.story: The stalk of flesh that holds the head up: the neck.
A spring in the flesh that gives out its fluid: a gland.
Raw flesh dotted with specks of blood: a fishy reek.

groups.title: sun 日 and weather
groups.note: The sun above: heat, light and dry spells.

chars.story: The sun beating down on everything: the heat of midsummer.
Light flickers and glints, and everything seems to sway.
The sun in a blue sky: a fine, clear day.
The sun on dry ground, with no rain: a drought.

groups.title: fire 火
groups.note: Fire, or four dots under it.

chars.story: A pot kept on a low flame for hours: simmer.
chars.note: Also 'endure': 熬过 'get through'; 熬夜 'stay up late'.

chars.story: A fire that crawls along the wick like a worm: a candle.
chars.note: 燭 became 烛: 蜀 became 虫.

chars.story: Fan the flames and make them leap: stir people up.
Fire sucks the moisture out until everything is dry.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person on the left: roles and acts.

chars.story: Treating a person as nothing: you insult them.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'insult'.

chars.story: A person at your right hand, helping you on: protection.
The person in the middle: the second of three, or mid-season.
chars.note: 仲裁 means a go-between settles a dispute.

chars.parts: 亼 roof + 匕 ladle shape
chars.story: A roofed measure with a ladle shape: you only meet it in gallon and Kunlun.
chars.note: A transliteration character: 加仑 gallon, 拿破仑 Napoleon. 侖 became 仑.

groups.title: earth 土
groups.note: Soil and ground.

chars.story: Earth made flat: a level patch of ground.
chars.note: Also a Japanese-style area unit, 1 ping.

chars.story: Earth heaped up over the dead: a grave mound.
chars.note: 墳 became 坟: the right side became 文.

chars.story: Two lumps of earth stacked: an old pointed jade tablet.
chars.note: Mostly a transliteration character (Guyana, Paraguay, Uruguay).

groups.title: small creatures
groups.note: Insects and sea animals.

chars.story: The flat-winged insect that flutters from flower to flower.
The insect that sits at the centre of its own web.
The fish with rough sandy skin: a shark.
chars.note: 鯊 became 鲨: 魚 became 鱼.

chars.story: A spotted beast that leaps lightly: the leopard.

groups.title: birds and nests
groups.note: Birds, their eggs and their homes.

chars.story: A small bird hopping about: a sparrow.

chars.parts: - a bird caught under a lid with a net
chars.story: Birds trapped under a cover: farm fowl.

chars.parts: - two round eggs inside a curved shell
chars.story: Two round eggs lie in a hollow shape: an egg.
chars.note: The scientific word for 蛋: 卵子 'ovum'.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 田 nest + 巛 chicks
chars.story: Chicks cheeping in a woven nest at the top of a tree.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Speech on the left: sayings and tricks.

chars.story: A few key words passed on: the trick of the trade.
chars.note: Also 'to part', as in 诀别 (a last farewell). 訣 became 诀: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words that lead you into danger: sly and deceptive.
chars.note: 詭 became 诡: 訁 became 讠.

groups.title: going about 辶
groups.note: A walking foot: moving, loitering, a trip.

chars.story: Walking up to someone and poking at them: tease.
chars.note: 逗号 is the comma mark.

chars.story: Walking about with no goal at all: a stroll.
A walk there and back: one whole run.
chars.note: A counter for trips: 去一趟 'go once'.

groups.title: wine 酉
groups.note: A wine jar: brewing and strong drink.

chars.parts: 酉 wine jar + 良 good
chars.story: Good stuff left in a wine jar until it turns: brew.
chars.note: 釀 became 酿: the right side became 良.

chars.story: A jar of wine left until it is rich and pure: mellow wine.
chars.note: Also 'mellow, rich': 醇厚.

groups.title: clothes 衤
groups.note: Cloth on the left: garments.

chars.parts: 衤 clothes + 彡 flowing strokes
chars.story: Clothing hanging loose in long lines: a shirt.
Cloth cut to an inch of the skin: the lining.
chars.note: 襯 became 衬: the right side became 寸.

groups.title: jade 王
groups.note: Jade beads on a string: fine stone.

chars.story: Fine jade from the capital: the best kind.
chars.note: Also the short name for Hainan (琼). 瓊 became 琼.

chars.story: Jade that glows from within: its luster.
chars.note: Mostly seen in 瑜伽 (yoga, a loanword).

groups.title: knife 刂
groups.note: A blade on the right: cut and scrape.

chars.story: A knife slices straight through to see inside.
A blade dragged flat along a surface: scrape, or blow hard.
chars.note: 颳 became 刮: 風 became 舌+刂.

groups.title: mountain 山
groups.note: Peaks and rock.

chars.story: A mountain that thrusts up above all the others.
A mountain reared up steep and hard to climb: harsh.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: A woman on the left or below.

chars.story: A woman held dear and fussed over: tender and fragile.
chars.note: 嬌 became 娇: 喬 became 乔.

chars.story: Good sense gone, and wild fancies take over: rash, baseless.

groups.title: boat and cart
groups.note: Things that carry people.

chars.parts: - a long hollow boat seen from the side
chars.story: A narrow hull with ribs: a small boat.
chars.note: Classical 'boat'; modern prose uses 船.

chars.story: A cart seat raised high and carried by bearers.
chars.note: 轎 became 轿: 車 became 车.

groups.title: soldiers, death and wrongs
groups.note: Hard words for harm.

chars.parts: - a lid over two plain figures and a cross
chars.story: A plain coat on a rank-and-file man: the foot soldier.
chars.note: Also 'finally', and 'to die'.

chars.story: A man cut down by a shot: he dies on the spot.
chars.note: 斃 became 毙: the top became 比.

chars.story: A weapon raised in the hand to strike: beat someone up.
chars.note: 毆 became 殴: 區 became 区.

chars.story: A rabbit pinned under a lid, innocent and unable to escape.

groups.title: virtue and effort
groups.note: Pushing yourself and keeping steady.

chars.story: Strength put in: you push yourself on.
A hand with a weapon that will not back down: firm.
A person standing calm under a clear sky: all is quiet.
chars.note: A name character and a political word (appeasement).

groups.title: song and verse
groups.note: Praising in words that rhyme.

chars.story: A head raised before everyone to sing a hymn.
chars.note: 頌 became 颂: 頁 became 页.

chars.story: Music evened out so each line matches the next: rhyme.
chars.note: 韻 became 韵: 員 became 匀.

groups.title: waste and excess
groups.note: Dirt, rot and too much.

chars.story: Rain every day in the damp: mold grows.
chars.note: 倒霉 'bad luck' is the most common word.

chars.story: What the body makes of rice: excrement.
chars.note: A crude word.

chars.story: Everything made big and showy: extravagance.

groups.title: things and people
groups.note: Small tools and a craftsman.

chars.story: A small ladle shape: the spoon.
chars.note: In 钥匙 it means key.

chars.story: A box of tools with an axe: the craftsman.
A nine with a dot added: a small rounded pill.
A tall roof open to the air: a pavilion.

groups.title: low and flat
groups.note: Size and shape.

chars.story: Measured against an arrow, it falls short: low.
A door-sized board with writing: a flat plaque.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Characters on their own, no neat family.

chars.story: A hand waving things away with flicks: don't!
chars.note: His Analects card: 'don't!'. In modern use mostly on signs, 请勿.

chars.story: A thread hidden under a lid: dark and mysterious.
The gas lighter than any other: hydrogen.
chars.note: 氫 became 氢: 輕 became 巠.

chars.story: Fields laid out in rows, each its own kind: farmland.
chars.note: In practice mostly seen in 范畴, 'category'. 疇 became 畴.

chars.parts: 酋 wine jar + 大 stand
chars.story: A jar of wine set firmly on its stand: an offering put in place.
Flourishing a thing about to show off or fool around.

sentences.en: The keys are on the table.
Do you want pepper on it?
My sister is shorter than you.
She is used to staying up late.
We have five days to go before the summer vacation.

sentences.zh: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。
sentences.en: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
